issues.title: Column alias casing
issues.problem: Column aliases should be consistently cased for readability.
issues.fix: SELECT ft.TRANSACTION_ID, ft.CUSTOMER_ID, dm.MERCHANT_NAME, ft.AMOUNT, ft.TRANSACTION_DATE, ft.STATUS

issues.title: Lack of comments
issues.problem: The query lacks comments explaining its purpose and logic.
issues.fix:
-- Top transactions by amount
SELECT ft.TRANSACTION_ID, ft.CUSTOMER_ID, dm.MERCHANT_NAME, ft.AMOUNT, ft.TRANSACTION_DATE, ft.STATUS
FROM FACT_TRANSACTIONS ft
INNER JOIN DIM_MERCHANT dm ON ft.MERCHANT_ID = dm.MERCHANT_ID
WHERE ft.STATUS = 'COMPLETED'
ORDER BY ft.AMOUNT DESC
LIMIT 100

review.corrected_sql:
-- Top transactions by amount
SELECT ft.TRANSACTION_ID, ft.CUSTOMER_ID, dm.MERCHANT_NAME, ft.AMOUNT, ft.TRANSACTION_DATE, ft.STATUS
FROM FACT_TRANSACTIONS ft
INNER JOIN DIM_MERCHANT dm ON ft.MERCHANT_ID = dm.MERCHANT_ID
WHERE ft.STATUS = 'COMPLETED'
ORDER BY ft.AMOUNT DESC
LIMIT 100
review.summary: The query is mostly correct but has minor readability issues with casing and lack of comments.
